category_title: Highly anxious or extremely shy students at risk of disengagement
scenario_title: Structured Q&A session with visiting adults
minimal_context: The student is in a classroom group forum preparing to ask a cloze question to visiting NRL players.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is your turn to ask your cloze question to the visiting NRL players in the group forum.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Keeps her head down, failing to make eye contact with the players or raise her hand for permission to speak.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please introduce yourself by name and school, and ask your question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains completely silent while the other students listen quietly, looking extremely shy.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are waiting for you to use a confident voice.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shrinks back in her seat, struggling to even speak to the kids her own age sitting next to her, let alone the visiting adults.)
